children.text: Changelog

children.name: text
children.text: Recent releases, newest first.

children.name: text
children.text: Standalone central panel, French translations, extended telemetry tier, credential maintenance, fleet-wide node inventory, Steam display names, security hardening, and upgrade notes.

children.name: text
children.text: Multicluster gateways: an optional private mTLS gateway manages game servers across independent clusters.

children.name: Bullet
children.text: Network capture, the gp-module authoring toolkit, PostgreSQL end-to-end support and user theme customization.

children.name: Bullet
children.text: REST and CLI console protocols, Helm-seeded OIDC role mappings and 14 new game modules (30 at v0.3.0; Hell Let Loose was withdrawn in v0.4.0).

children.name: text
children.text: Wake-on-connect: a sentinel holds game ports while a server sleeps and wakes it on the first connection.

children.name: Bullet
children.text: Load-balancer address pools: request a specific pool or address (MetalLB or Cilium).

children.name: Bullet
children.text: Signing key rotated to ECDSA P-256; releases recorded in the Rekor transparency log.

children.name: text
children.text: WebSocket console, logs, files and players routes enforce per-server access.

children.name: Bullet
children.text: Hostport exposure binds only advertised template ports.

children.name: Bullet
children.text: Failed modules can be uninstalled; SSE and WebSocket streams survive long sessions.

children.name: text
children.text: Four new remote-console protocols and per-GameServer access control.

children.name: Bullet
children.text: Read-only MCP server, native S3 audit sink, and an admin System Logs viewer.

children.name: Bullet
children.text: OIDC group-to-role mapping, ntfy notifications, and direct mod file upload.

children.name: text
children.text: Public cosign key published; tagged releases get a GitHub Release page.

children.name: Bullet
children.text: Launch of the public marketing and docs website.

children.name: text
children.text: Fleet metrics for GameServers and Backups.

children.name: Bullet
children.text: Audit-log CSV/JSON export, webhook push sink, and a syslog relay.

children.name: text
children.text: Added: bundled observability — Prometheus alerts and a Grafana dashboard, signed module bundles with Cosign verification.

children.name: text
children.text: Breaking: CRD API group renamed kestrel.gg → gameplane.local as part of the project's rebrand to Gameplane.

children.name: text
children.text: First beta: GameServer lifecycle, console/logs/files/players, backups & restore, signed OCI modules, RBAC & audit.
